name: help-overlay
notes: The largest always-available overlay and the one with the most render paths (filter box, two-column shortcut/slash split, scrolling). Also exercises the /help TOGGLE bug class from iter-82: pressing it twice must show the same overlay, not two different ones — hence the close variant, which baselines the Esc path too. POST-CUTOVER: operant's help table was deleted with the dispatch; the ported chrome draws its own help (operant_ui/ui_overlays.rs::draw_help_overlay), whose ground truth is the /help entry line and the scroll footer. (iter-1785) The 100x30 variant is the FILTERED view: `/help model` opens the overlay filtered on the term, and the Commands view renders the filter — before iter-1785 the Commands view never read HelpOverlay::filter, so every keystroke typed in /help was swallowed by a filter no render consulted, and `/help <command>` dropped its argument on the floor. The variant pins the filtered frame: the /model row is on screen and /changelog is not.
